prompt: 「我昨天去看電影。」哪一句翻得最正確？
options: I went to see a movie yesterday.
I yesterday went to see a movie.
I go to see a movie yesterday.
answer: I went to see a movie yesterday.

時間副詞可以放在句首或句尾；中文語序直接放進句中比較不自然。
yesterday 表示過去，動詞要用過去式 went。

why: 昨天是過去式，時間副詞放句尾最自然。
tip: 時間副詞放句尾，動詞要配合時態。
say: I went to see a movie yesterday.

prompt: 中文：「下雨了，所以比賽取消了。」哪一句翻得最自然？
options: It rained, so the game was canceled.
Because it rained, so the game was canceled.
It rained, because the game was canceled.
answer: It rained, so the game was canceled.

wrong.Because it rained, so the game was cance: 英文中 because 和 so 不能同時使用，這是中文習慣。
wrong.It rained, because the game was canceled: 這樣把因果顛倒，變成因為比賽取消才下雨。

why: 英文只要用一個連接詞表示因果：so 或 because，不能同時用。
tip: because 和 so 不能一起用。
say: It rained, so the game was canceled.

prompt: 中文：「有很多學生喜歡這堂課。」
text: _____ many students who like this class.
options: There are
There have
It has

wrong.There have: There have 不能表示「有」，存在句要用 there is／are。
wrong.It has: It has 的主詞 It 不能代表很多學生，語意不通。

why: 表示「有……」的存在句用 there be，many students 是複數，所以用 are。
tip: 中文「有」常翻成 There be。
say: There are many students who like this class.

prompt: 「他建議我多運動。」哪一句才是正確的？
options: He suggested that I exercise more.
He suggested me to exercise more.
He suggested that I exercised more.
answer: He suggested that I exercise more.

suggest 不接「人 + to V」，要用 suggest that 子句或 suggest V-ing。
suggest 後面的 that 子句用原形動詞（虛擬語氣），不用過去式。

why: suggest that + 主詞 + (should) 原形動詞，表示建議。
tip: suggest that 後面接原形動詞。
say: He suggested that I exercise more.

prompt: 中文：「這個計畫值得一試。」哪個英文最道地？
options: This plan is worth trying.
This plan is worth to try.
This plan is worth of trying.

worth 後面接 V-ing，不接 to V。
worth 本身是介系詞性質，後面不再加 of。

why: be worth + V-ing 表示值得做某事。

prompt: 中文：「我不知道怎麼回答這個問題。」哪一句最好？
options: I don't know how to answer this question.
I don't know how answer this question.
I don't know how I answer to this question.
answer: I don't know how to answer this question.

how 後面要接 to V，缺少 to。
wrong.I don't know how I answer to this questi: answer 作「回答」及物動詞，不加 to，語序也不自然。

why: how to + 原形動詞 表示怎麼做；answer 是及物動詞。
say: I don't know how to answer this question.

prompt: 「這本書是我朋友寫的。」哪一句才是正確的？
options: This book was written by my friend.
This book is written by my friend yesterday.
This book wrote by my friend.
answer: This book was written by my friend.

wrong.This book is written by my friend yester: yesterday 表示過去，被動式要用 was written。
書是被寫的，要用被動語態 was written，不是 wrote。

why: 主詞是物，動作由人完成，用被動語態 was written by。
tip: 主詞是被動作的對象：be + p.p.。
say: This book was written by my friend.

prompt: 中文：「天氣太冷了，我們沒辦法去游泳。」
text: It was _____ cold for us to go swimming.
options: too
so
very

wrong.so: so 後面需要接 that 子句，若用 for us to go 就要用 too。
wrong.very: very 只表示非常，不含「導致無法」的意思。

why: too + 形容詞 + to V 表示太……而不能……。
say: It was too cold for us to go swimming.

prompt: The more you read, the more you learn. 最自然的中文意思是？
text: The more you read, the more you learn.
options: 讀得越多，學得越多。
你讀很多，所以學很少。
越學習，越不想讀。

wrong.你讀很多，所以學很少。: The more..., the more... 表示成正比，不是相反。
wrong.越學習，越不想讀。: 句中沒有表達不想讀的意思，兩者同步增加。

why: The + 比較級..., the + 比較級... 表示越……越……。
say: The more you read, the more you learn.

prompt: 「我花了兩小時寫報告。」哪一句才是正確的？
options: It took me two hours to write the report.
It spent me two hours to write the report.
I took two hours write the report.
answer: It took me two hours to write the report.

wrong.It spent me two hours to write the repor: spend 的主詞要是人，It 當虛主詞時要用 take。
缺少 to，且句型應是 It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V。

why: It takes/took + 人 + 時間 + to V 是表達花費時間的句型。
tip: 花多久做某事：It took me... to V。
say: It took me two hours to write the report.

prompt: 中文：「這麼做的結果是，我們省下很多錢。」哪個翻譯最道地？
options: As a result, we saved a lot of money.
As result, we saved a lot of money.
Because result, we saved a lot of money.
answer: As a result, we saved a lot of money.

As a result 是固定片語，a 不能省略。
because 是連接詞，後面要接子句，不能直接接 result。

why: as a result 是固定的連接語，表示結果。
tip: as a result：結果，a 不可省。
say: As a result, we saved a lot of money.
